clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, newly raised Forsaken paladins face the pain of calling on the Holy Light. Aramis Hammerhand teaches them to heal wounded Deathguards through the burning agony.

Newly risen Forsaken paladins must face a hard truth: the Holy Light still answers them, but burns their withered bodies. Many were champions of the Silver Hand or knights of Lordaeron before they fell. Aramis Hammerhand teaches them that powers once used without thought now bring fierce pain. The Light clashes with the foul magic that sustains undeath, so calling on it takes resolve and endurance.

Deathguards in Deathknell suffer grievous wounds fighting mindless zombies, and Forsaken paladins are called to heal them. Aramis teaches that pushing through the burning pain is like exercising an atrophied muscle. The paladins treat that agony as a badge of honor and proof that the Light has not forsaken them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others.

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Mastery of the light will return, in time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances.
Be well and walk in the light once more, paladin.
